value.main_text_excerpt:
Workflow
Our systematic approach to delivering mechatronic solutions, from initial consultation to final deployment.
Our Team
Our multidisciplinary team covers control theory, embedded software, mechanical design and project management, ensuring end-to-end delivery for demanding applications.
Sondre Sanden Tørdal, Ph.D.
CEO & Founder
Sondre has extensive experience in developing advanced motion technologies using multisensory systems in both academic and industrial applications.
Andreas Klausen, Ph.D.
Senior R&D Specialist
Andreas is an experienced researcher and has a lot of experience related to advanced algorithm development for real-time systems, signal processing, and AI/ML applications.
Håvard Nygård, BSc.
Mechatronics Engineer
Håvard has experience in developing embedded controllers and custom circuitry for real-time applications.
Thomas Lønne Stiansen, MSc.
Mechatronics Engineer
Thomas has a strong interest in robotics and mechatronics, combining experience in model-based control design, machine vision and system integration
Julie Madelen Madshaven, MSc.
Office Manager
Julie has a background in educational technology, primarily in the fields of UI/UX design, user-centered design methods, and e-learning technologies.
Partners and Customers
